name: Jariel Balberona
headline: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Senior software engineer with 9+ years building and modernizing production systems across frontend, backend, and delivery infrastructure. Strong in React and TypeScript applications, Node.js APIs, PostgreSQL-backed products, and cloud delivery across AWS and Azure. I focus on maintainability, clean system boundaries, and reliable shipping under real product pressure.

experience.summary: Worked on the modernization of a legacy React frontend for a construction project management platform.
highlights: Worked closely with the CTO and design team to align frontend architecture, UI implementation, and delivery priorities across the product.
Led a major frontend modernization across React 17 to 19, CRA to Vite, and SASS to Tailwind CSS v4 to reduce build friction and improve iteration speed.
Re-architected the frontend into feature-based modules with reusable hooks and clearer ownership boundaries to improve maintainability and parallel development.
Reworked state and data patterns from Redux-heavy flows to TanStack Query and Zustand, using cache-first query design, structured invalidation, and optimistic updates where appropriate.
Strengthened engineering quality through Vitest and stricter modular boundaries to reduce regressions and improve delivery confidence.

experience.summary: Worked on product engineering for a chat-driven AI analytics platform, with focus on workflow clarity, analytics UX, and product reliability.
highlights: Expanded in-chat analytics rendering to support advanced charts such as heatmaps, treemaps, and stacked bar visualizations for exploratory analysis.
Built Agents V1 orchestration UI, a node-based workflow builder covering data source, prompt, condition, and recipient flows.
Improved visibility into query and result states so analytics workflows were easier for users to understand and trust.

experience.role: Senior Software Engineer to DevOps Engineer
experience.summary: Progressed from software engineering into DevOps and platform work across product modernization, delivery systems, observability, and reporting infrastructure.
highlights: Modernized a legacy product through incremental adoption of Next.js, Tailwind, Jotai, tRPC, and Prisma while preserving compatibility with an existing database and ongoing production use.
Improved React application performance and frontend responsiveness through better state and rendering discipline.
Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation using Terraform and Docker, improving release repeatability and reducing manual operational work.
Supported production observability with Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki for monitoring, logging, and diagnostics.
Contributed to Power BI enablement and cloud data-platform support across AWS and Azure in collaboration with the data team.

experience.summary: Led frontend engineering for a cleaning booking platform covering appointments, schedules, and customer workflows.
highlights: Led frontend engineering for a cleaning services booking platform covering appointments, schedules, and customer-facing service workflows.
Owned frontend structure and UI delivery, improving maintainability and feature scalability as the product grew.
Optimized data fetching with Apollo Client and added error tracking and analytics instrumentation to improve reliability and product visibility.
